membership_read.name: membership_read
membership_read.using: case when nullif(current_setting('snapform.workspace_id', true), '') is null then "membership"."user_id" = current_setting('snapform.user_id', true) else "membership"."workspace_id"::text = current_setting('snapform.workspace_id', true) end

workspace_read.name: workspace_read
workspace_read.using: exists (select 1 from public.membership m where m.workspace_id = "workspace"."id" and m.user_id = current_setting('snapform.user_id', true))

draft_operation_read.name: draft_operation_read
draft_operation_read.using:
"draft_operation"."workspace_id"::text = current_setting('snapform.workspace_id', true)

      where m.workspace_id = "draft_operation"."workspace_id"

response_session_submission.name: response_session_submission
response_session_submission.value: ("response_session"."status" = 'collecting' and "response_session"."submitted_at" is null and "response_session"."ending_id" is null) or ("response_session"."status" = 'submitted' and "response_session"."submitted_at" is not null and "response_session"."ending_id" is not null)

    and exists (select 1 from public.membership m
      where m.workspace_id = "response_outbox"."workspace_id"

response_email_lease.name: response_email_lease
response_email_lease.value: ("response_email_delivery"."status"='sending' and "response_email_delivery"."lease_token" is not null and "response_email_delivery"."lease_until" is not null and "response_email_delivery"."first_attempt_at" is not null) or ("response_email_delivery"."status"<>'sending' and "response_email_delivery"."lease_token" is null and "response_email_delivery"."lease_until" is null)

response_email_state.name: response_email_state
response_email_state.value: ("response_email_delivery"."status" in ('pending','sending','accepted','delivered','bounced','complained','failed','suppressed') and "response_email_delivery"."reason" is null) or ("response_email_delivery"."status"='cancelled' and "response_email_delivery"."reason" is not distinct from 'disabled') or ("response_email_delivery"."status"='needs_action' and coalesce("response_email_delivery"."reason",'') in ('recipient-unavailable','configuration','provider-rejected','idempotency-expired','attempts-exhausted'))
